scope: aggregation of the frozen STEP 49 execution and the STEP 46 preregistered window-level bootstrap; first and only evaluation of H_EXT

endpoint.naHandling: a window without a valid pair is NOT_AVAILABLE, excluded from Theta at that horizon, and RETAINED in the bootstrap sampling frame; never imputed
endpoint.perDrifter: delta_i(h) = E_C,i(h) - E_A,i(h); E = haversine(model, observed) at exactly t0+h, R = 6371008.8 m, km
endpoint.pooledDrifterMedian: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never the primary endpoint
endpoint.primary: Theta_extension(h) = median over windows with >= 1 valid pair
endpoint.weighting: equal window weighting; drifter-count never weights a window
endpoint.window: Delta_w(h) = median over the window's VALID C-A paired drifter deltas

bootstrap.samplingFrame: ALL 6 registered extension windows, NOT_AVAILABLE windows included
bootstrap.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(20260946); rng.integers(0, 6, size=6) per replicate, sequential; fresh stream per horizon

decisionRule.text: STEP 46: H_EXT SUPPORTED iff descriptive label == CANDIDATE_EXTENSION_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED AND window-level Q0.975 < 0 km AND the gate is satisfied; BLOCKED if the gate fails
decisionRule.criterionDivergenceHandling: the STEP 46 preregistered descriptive-favour criterion (frozen STEP 30A rule on pooled 72 h pairs) governs; the criterion stated in the STEP 50 directive (Theta_extension(72h) < 0) is computed and reported beside it, never merged and never used to override the preregistration

separationFromPrimary.note: the primary 9-window cohort and the extension 6-window cohort are never summed or pooled

permitted: validation extension whose geographic domain is separate from the primary cohort
independenceLanguage.step45cNote: the original STEP 44 validation attempt produced no performance evaluation at all, so nothing from it is pooled with extension performance
